Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling through the intersection in Katy, Texas, and was completing a left turn when the vehicle was
struck on the driver's side by Driver 2, who was proceeding straight through on the cross street. Responding officers
arrived and found both vehicles resting in the roadway with visible front-end damage to Driver 2's vehicle and a
crushed driver-side door and quarter panel on Driver 1's vehicle, consistent with the angle and speed of the impact
described at the scene. Driver 2 stated that the collision occurred as Driver 1 turned in front of them, and two
independent witnesses gave statements that match that account. Photographs taken at the scene were reviewed and
show damage patterns consistent with the reported sequence. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle was observed or
reported. Driver 1 reported neck and lower back pain and was evaluated by medical personnel on scene. Driver 1
was the operator of the vehicle, and it was not fully clear from the statements where in the vehicle they were seated at
the moment of impact. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy covering the vehicle. A passenger in Driver
1's vehicle was not reported as injured.
